This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This is first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on behalf of applicant for grant of bail.

T he applicant is in custody since 31.01.2024 in connection with Crime No.42/2024, registered at P.S. - Mandideep, District- Raisen (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of the IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of the POCSO Act, 2012.

Prosecution story in short is that on complaint of father of the prosecutrix Police lodged missing report FIR was filed under section 363 of IPC and after disclosure of the facts by the prosecutrix ,
offence under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and sectio 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act was added and found that the applicant has committed aforesaid offence.
Hence, Police arrested the applicant and send him to jail.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
It is stated that at the time of incident prosecutrix was aged about 18 years.
She was consenting party.
Statement under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. were recorded wherein she has stated nothing against the present applicant.
Earlier also she went with the applicant.
Appellant is custody since 31.01.2024.
Charge sheet has been filed and trial will take considerable time.
On the basis of aforesaid, it is prayed to enlarge the applicant on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the applicant.
Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
